name: Xinjiang Communications Construction Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Communications Construction Group Co., Ltd. principally engages in the construction of highways, bridges, and traffic safety facilities; technology maintenance; as well as road and bridge testing. It also engages in the provision of purchase of equipment and materials, warehousing logistics, project pricing, machinery lease, and design consultancy services. The company was founded on January 27, 1999 and is headquartered in Urumqi, China.
